packet_layer.audio_start: 0x400, or 0x800 when preceded by 1KB 0xFF annotation block (Pinkston, taxis)
packet_layer.header_10B: 00 NN | 00 0a | SIZES be_u16 | AA BB CC | DD
packet_layer.SIZES: bytes used in packet INCLUDING 10B header; 0x0400=1024 full; partial final packets: MSV 82, Pinkston 442, budgtele 718, taxis 40
packet_layer.AA_BB_CC: per-file constant triple: MSV 0e3081, budgtele 0c4668, Pinkston 103da4, taxis ffffff (unset)
packet_layer.DD: slow monotonic counter +1 per ~2s: MSV 8c->91 (1 per 4 pkts), budgtele 48->5b, Pinkston e7->e9, taxis ff (unset); semantics unknown
